keyEvents.text: Ian Luccas (Alverca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Pedro Rosas (Casa Pia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Alverca 0, Casa Pia 1. Selvi Clua (Casa Pia) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Henrique Araújo with a cross.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Davy Gui (Alverca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury João Rego (Casa Pia).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Chiquinho (Alverca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Casa Pia. Mohamed Salah replaces Jérémy Livolant.
Substitution, Alverca. André Vidigal replaces Francisco Chissumba.
Substitution, Alverca. Rayan Lucas replaces Davy Gui.
Goal! Alverca 1, Casa Pia 1. Ian Luccas (Alverca) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Chiquinho with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Alverca. Vivaldo Semedo replaces Dawda Camara.
Substitution, Alverca. Matheus França replaces Figueiredo.
Substitution, Casa Pia. Rochinha replaces Benjamin Pauwels.
Substitution, Casa Pia. Lawrence Ofori replaces Selvi Clua.
Substitution, Casa Pia. Cassiano replaces Henrique Araújo.
Substitution, Alverca. Cédric Nuozzi replaces Chiquinho.
Second Half ends, Alverca 1, Casa Pia 1.
